app.name: Pulse

forbidden.title: You can't open this

home.emptyBody: Create a profile for yourself or for a family member, or join a family with an invite code.

family.subtitleManage: Choose who is in the family and what each person sees.
family.notJoined: {name} hasn't joined yet. Invite them as the patient so they control who sees what.
invite.title: Invite someone
invite.ownerNote: They will own this profile and decide what everyone sees.

home.insightsLink: What seems to move the sugar
insights.title: Insights
insights.chartSubtitle: Shaded band: target range {low} to {high} mg/dL

insights.needMore: Log {count} more after-dinner readings to see what affects your sugar.
insight.mealDinner: After dinners with {high}, sugar seems to run higher: it averaged {highAvg}. With {low}, {lowAvg}.
insight.meal: After meals with {high}, sugar seems to run higher: it averaged {highAvg}. With {low}, {lowAvg}.
insight.walkLower: The morning after a walk, fasting sugar seems lower: it averaged {walked}, against {rest} after days without a walk.
insight.walkHigher: The morning after a walk, fasting sugar seems higher: it averaged {walked}, against {rest} after days without a walk.
insight.meds: In weeks with most doses taken, fasting sugar averaged {good}. In weeks with more missed doses, {low}.
insight.trend.up: This week's fasting average is {now}, up from {last} last week.
insight.trend.down: This week's fasting average is {now}, down from {last} last week.
insight.trend.steady: This week's fasting average is {now}, about the same as last week ({last}).
share.title: Doctor link
share.subtitle: Before the clinic visit: add the latest HbA1c and send the doctor a one-page summary of {name}'s last 90 days.
share.hba1cHint: From the lab report, as a percent.
share.error.date: Enter a date that isn't in the future
share.linkHint: Read-only, no login, works for 7 days. You can cancel it any time.
share.ready: Link ready. Send it to the doctor.
share.whatsappText: {name}'s 90-day sugar summary from Pulse (read-only, valid 7 days): {url}
share.inactive: This link is no longer active
share.inactiveBody: It has expired or was cancelled. Ask the patient's family for a new one.
doctor.noPatterns: Not enough data for patterns yet.
doctor.noMood: No weekly check in this period.
doctor.footer: Patient-reported readings from a home glucometer, logged in the Pulse app. Plain averages, not a diagnosis.
demo.syntheticLong: Synthetic demo data, not a real patient
settings.title: Profile settings
settings.limitsHint: Change these only on the doctor's instruction. Readings below {urgentLow} or at {urgentHigh} and above are always urgent.
settings.deleteHint: This permanently removes {name}'s profile, readings, meals, medicines, checks and doctor links for everyone in the family. It cannot be undone.
push.denied: Blocked. Allow notifications for Pulse in Chrome settings.
push.dueBody: Your {time} dose. Tap Taken after you take it.
